# 枫月对决
Side-view friendly duel between 小司 and 脏脏包. Buildless HTML/Canvas2D. Real GLB model/runtime poses are pre-rendered into sprite sheets, preserving original appearance without requiring WebGL. 8 frames × 5 states per character. Input: A/D move, Space jump, J melee chain, K ranged, L/Shift dash, U ultimate, Esc pause. Choice of either character, AI with telegraph, health/energy/cooldowns, victory/retry, touch buttons.

## Validation
`node test.mjs`: melee, ranged damage, energy gate, movement, jump landing, AI and end condition, pause. Browser: actual rendering, start, movement, combat feedback, help, character select, replay. No external runtime dependencies.

## Assets
See dist/credits.html and dist/assets/effects/SOURCES.md. Character source spz_lovehome commit 889e0fa0ede73b67ff92c6b9dabb7512428b8417. Original source files unchanged. Kenney Particle Pack CC0 textures tinted and animated.

## v2 feedback pass
Characters reduced approximately 16%. Full-bleed background and brighter stone paving replace all letterboxing. Actor ground is explicitly mapped to the same terrace line across aspect ratios; cat foot-center pivot corrected. Higher jump, air steering, jump buffer through short stun, dash-through and symmetric bounded collision. Layered skill arcs, comet tails, impacts, ultimate pillars, landing rings, hitstop tiers and smooth trauma-squared shake; reduced-motion control.

`node layout-test.mjs` verifies no background margins and shared ground at 1920×1080, 2560×1080, 1366×768, 1188×761, 390×844, 844×390, 1024×768. Physics tests include live-AI left/right corner jump-over for both characters, 2,000 wall-pressure frames, dash escape and buffered jump.

V3 verification: `node test.mjs`, `node layout-test.mjs`, `node vfx-test.mjs` pass. ## V5.1 — single-body walking and reliable giant pounce
- Replaced translucent adjacent-frame/pose crossfades with one opaque sprite sample. Each original character now has a dedicated 16-frame rig-rendered walking atlas, alternating leg support and distance-driven gait; dash-only intentional trails remain. `tools/render-walk.py` records derivation. Fast combat movement is unchanged, so short chibi strides are stylized rather than strict foot-planted locomotion.
- Giant pounce has its own lifecycle independent of the interruptible attack: grows to 2.1x after takeoff, remains enlarged through flight and 180ms landing impact, shrinks over170ms. Airborne interruption retains visual growth but correctly cancels landing damage. Charge cancel, KO, timeout and reset clean up. Wall visual bounds account for actual pivot/facing; combat hitboxes/balance unchanged.
- Browser frame-stepping verified cat/Xiaosi left and right gait, both-facing giant flight, airborne interruption, wall bounds and grounded normal-size recovery. Core and sprite regression tests cover lifecycle, cooldown, cleanup, exact one-body drawing, and mirrored bounds. Local browser preview is verified; production is owner-private and shows its sign-in gate to this browser.
